narr: As high pressure responsible for excessive heat began to weaken, monsoon moisture seeped into the Mojave Desert, fueling a round of thunderstorms. Severe winds, flash flooding, and a landspout occurred.
ev: Flag Mine Road was closed due to flooding.
Signal Road was closed from Highway 93 to Alamo Road due to flooding.
Bogeles Ranch Road was closed from Upper Trout Creek Road to Bogeles Ranch due to flooding.
Pierce Ferry Road was damaged by flooding in multiple areas between Highway 93 and mile marker 3.
Antares Road was closed from Route 66 to Pierce Ferry Road due to flooding.
Two to two and a half feet of water flowed over DW Ranch Road from the Frees Wash.
